title: Elden Ring
description: A new fantasy action RPG adventure set in the Lands Between.
critic_summary:
What people like: Open-world exploration, build variety, and boss design.
What people dislike: Steep difficulty spikes and occasional performance issues.
user_summary:
What people like: Freedom to explore and co-op moments.
What people dislike: Cryptic quest directions for some players.
youtube_takeaway:
Streamers praise the sense of discovery and tense boss fights.
